name: Precipalm - Tree Counting
description: Collaborated with IPB University to develop an end-to-end tree counting and identification system for oil palm plantations. Led full-stack development—from YOLO-based ML modeling to deployment with FastAPI and Next.js. This project aimed to replace traditional fertilization estimation methods, potentially saving thousands of dollars in wasted resources annually.

name: Nongkee
description: An app that helps users discover fun conversation topics during hangouts. Built the backend using Go with a focus on speed, simplicity, and scalability.
